<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/circles"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns only the circles **you** belong to in that group. There is
deliberately no endpoint that lists every circle in a group: circles
are fully private, so a member outside one must not be able to learn
it exists. An empty list therefore means "none that concern you", not
"none exist".
